answer: Pay agents from an escrow that vests only after a random peer re-runs the job and confirms the result. Each identity posts an onyx deposit that funds the re-check; a raven audit picks a few jobs at random, so a sybil farm cannot know which of its thousand fake outputs will be inspected. One failed check burns the deposit and freezes the whole identity cluster, and the ripple of that freeze blocks its pending payouts. Running one honest identity costs almost nothing, but running a thousand fakes means a thousand deposits at risk for the same total payout.
